issues.problem: The single-view (M=1, the benchmarked Table 2 path) scoring is re-implemented inline (reciprocal(h_train+lam), sort descending) instead of calling selection.eig_scores, so the eig-selection probe does not cover the code that actually runs; active-loop (fisher) only checks budget/restore/pool, not that the pick is the argmax of an independent score or that H_train sums the selected views.
issues.evidence: probes.eig_selection tests selection.eig_scores/greedy_batch only; probes.active_loop never recomputes the Fisher score. Code inspection shows the inline formula is correct (matches H_reg.select_single_view: sum(H_c * 1/(H_train+1e-6)), descending sort, H_train over current train_idxs before extend).
issues.fix: Route the M=1 branch through selection.eig_scores (streamed) or add to active_loop a check that the fisher pick equals argmax of independently computed sum_k H_c/(sum_{s in S} H_s + lam) from fisher.diag_hessian.

issues.problem: The lego smoke (Fisher 22.33 < random 22.82) is not diagnostic: 2000 effective its, all four acquisitions (it 100/225/375/550) happen at cur_iter <= ~175 after a restore, before any densification (gaussians=100000 at every selection), i.e. Fisher is scoring an almost untrained random 100k cloud whose score is dominated by 1/(0+1e-6) terms of Gaussians unseen by the train views. I found no sign/normalisation/H_train bug that would make Fisher systematically worse.
issues.fix: State this in the report; judge only the 8-scene benchmark gain vs +0.79 dB.

issues.problem: With 10 views the last round (25600 effective its at p=0.1) needs ~256k loop steps alone; total expected ~336k loop steps, so --steps 230000 would fail (loudly, at evaluation). Seq1 (mean 218.0k, sd 1.3k, max 222.7k over 5000 simulations) and seq4 (~210k) are fine with 230000.
issues.evidence: Simulation of negative-binomial loop counts per round with the official load_its.
issues.fix: Document the required --steps per variant (v10 ~ 360000) in README/plan.

issues.problem: Two small official-loop differences are not listed: (a) official densify_and_prune/reset run before optimizer.step on the same iteration's grads (runtime steps Adam first, as in the shared gsplat baseline); (b) official viewpoint_stack is not refreshed after an acquisition, so the new view is first used only after the stale stack empties (listed only as 'with replacement').
issues.fix: Add one line each to the fidelity gaps.

issues.problem: Kernel probe runs a 40x32 image with 10 Gaussians (few tiles); the 800x800 multi-tile path is only exercised in the smoke. Kernel source is byte-identical to the official diff/, so risk is low.
issues.evidence: diff -r source/code/diff plugin/ss_fisherrf/csrc: only packaging files differ.

verified_claims.fisher_statistic: Official H = sum over pixels of squared d(R+G+B)_p/dtheta of the candidate's rendered colour (pred_img.backward(ones)), no GT/photometric loss, white bg; port uses the byte-identical kernel and the same activation chaining.
verified_claims.scoring: sum H_c/(H_train+1e-6); H_train = sum over currently selected views (recomputed each round with the current model, before adding the new view); no extra prior beyond lambda.
verified_claims.schedule: Table 2 seq1: 4 init, +1 at 100*|S| -> 400..18400, 30000 iterations (scripts/blender_seq1.sh); SH +1 every 5000 absolute its, degree 0 after restore; densify 500..10000 on cur_iter, reset at cur%3000 and cur==500.
verified_claims.steps_accounting: Runtime means-LR overwrite (runtime.py:209) is overridden by the controller before every training step; SH degree, density, and LR all use the effective/cur_iter clock; run fails at evaluation if <30000 effective its. seq1 expected loop steps 218.0k +- 1.3k (max 222.7k / 5000 sims) < 230000.
verified_claims.data: 100 train views in file order (index 0 = r_0), 200 test, white composite truncated to 8 bit, 800x800, 100k U[-1.3,1.3]^3 points with np seed 0, SH2RGB colours via uint8 storePly; runtime 3dgs recipe gives opacity 0.1, 3-NN scales, camera extent 1.1*max radius.

summary: Faithful port of the official FisherRF GS code. The Fisher kernel is the official diff/ unchanged and is driven exactly like H_reg (colour render backprop with ones, squared per-pixel grads, rotation filtered, all SH bands, lambda=1e-6 on H_train). The schedule, restore-to-init, LR/densify/SH clocks and data prep match active_train.py and the Blender loader; the loop-step budget is sufficient for seq1/seq4. No critical or major issues; minors are probe coverage of the inline M=1 scoring, a non-diagnostic smoke, v10 step budget, and two unlisted small loop-ordering gaps. Unit tests (5) and ss-verify (7/7, CUDA) re-run and pass.
